Reminiscing about childhood experiences, an African American man and a South American man were sharing stories that were both sad and touching. The African American man recalled day-long fishing trips with his father and how, now that his father has passed away, he really misses those experiences of bonding. But the South American mentioned that because his father left him and his mom when he was only a year old, he ended up bonding with a neighbor, who would also take him fishing sometimes. Who was abandoned by their father?
A. The South American man
B. The African American man
C. Not answerable
